import pandas as pd
from feast import FeatureStore

store = FeatureStore(repo_path=".")

entity_df = pd.DataFrame({
    "driver_id": [1001, 1002],
    "event_timestamp": [
        pd.Timestamp("2026-07-01 10:00:00"),
        pd.Timestamp("2026-07-03 14:30:00"),
    ],
})

training_df = store.get_historical_features(
    entity_df=entity_df,
    features=["driver_hourly_stats:avg_daily_trips"],
).to_df()
caption: Each row gets the feature value as of its own event_timestamp — never a later one.
